shortDescription: Adds a new DLP policy rule

options.name: action
options.description: The action taken when traffic matches the DLP policy rule criteria.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: auditor
options.description: The auditor to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: cloud_applications
options.description: The list of cloud applications to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: departments
options.description: The departments to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the DLP policy rule.

options.name: dlp_download_scan_enabled
options.description: If this field is set to true, DLP scan is enabled for file downloads from cloud applications configured in the rule. If this field is set to false, DLP scan is disabled for downloads from the cloud applications.

options.name: dlp_engines
options.description: The list of DLP engines to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enables or disables the DLP policy rule.

options.name: eun_template_id
options.description: The EUN template ID associated with the rule

options.name: exclude_domain_profiles
options.description: The list of domain profiles that must be added to the DLP rule criteria in order to apply the DLP rules. It applies to all domains excluding the domains that are part of the specified profiles. A maximum of 8 profiles can be selected.

options.name: excluded_departments
options.description: The departments that are excluded from the DLP policy rule.

options.name: excluded_groups
options.description: The groups that are excluded from the DLP policy rule.

options.name: excluded_users
options.description: The users that are excluded from the DLP policy rule.

options.name: external_auditor_email
options.description: The email address of an external auditor to whom DLP email notifications are sent..

options.name: file_types
options.description: The list of file types to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: icap_server
options.description: The DLP server using ICAP to which the transaction content is forwarded.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for the DLP policy rule.

options.name: include_domain_profiles
options.description: The list of domain profiles that must be added to the DLP rule criteria in order to apply the DLP rules. Only to domains that are part of the specified profiles. A maximum of 8 profiles can be selected.

options.name: labels
options.description: The rule labels associated to the DLP policy rule.

options.name: location_groups
options.description: The locations groups to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: locations
options.description: The locations to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: match_only
options.description: The match only criteria for DLP engines.

options.name: min_size
options.description: The minimum file size (in KB) used for evaluation of the DLP policy rule..

options.name: name
options.description: The DLP policy rule name.

options.name: notification_template
options.description: The template used for DLP notification emails.

options.name: order
options.description: The rule order of execution for the DLP policy rule with respect to other rules.

options.name: parent_rule
options.description: The unique identifier of the parent rule under which an exception rule is added.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: protocols
options.description: The protocol criteria specified for the DLP policy rule

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: rank
options.description: The admin rank of the admin who created the DLP policy rule.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: severity
options.description: Indicates the severity selected for the DLP rule violation.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: time_windows
options.description: The time windows to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: url_categories
options.description: The list of URL categories to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: user_risk_score_levels
options.description: Indicates the user risk level selected for the DLP rule violation.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: The users to which the DLP policy rule must be applied.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: without_content_inspection
options.description: Indicates a DLP policy rule without content inspection, when the value is set to true.

options.name: workload_groups
options.description: The list of preconfigured workload groups to which the policy must be applied.

options.name: zcc_notifications_enabled
options.description: If this field is set to true, Zscaler Client Connector notification is enabled for the block action triggered by the web DLP rule. If this field is set to false, Zscaler Client Connector notification is disabled.

options.name: zscaler_incident_receiver
options.description: Indicates whether a Zscaler Incident Receiver is associated to the DLP policy rule.
